verdict.rationale: React updates the screen to match new data without hand-written diffing, using its own runtime DOM abstraction with change management. React Compiler optimizes components at build time and removes the need for manual useMemo, useCallback and React.memo, with incremental adoption and debugging docs. However, the evidence shows the compiler handles memoization, not compiling components into direct, surgical DOM updates; DOM updates still go through React's runtime reconciliation. Missing for 10: evidence the compiler emits fine-grained, surgical DOM update code; independent or hands-on corroboration of the compiler's performance gains.
